data: Does the blue line achieves a performance over 0.6?

The blue line represents the F1 score in the learning curve of 10-fold cross-validation. The y-axis shows the performance, which ranges from 0 to 1. The x-axis represents the percentage of all annotated data used in training, ranging from 10% to 90%. The blue line starts at approximately 0.4 on the y-axis and increases gradually, reaching a peak around 0.6. Therefore, the blue line does achieve a performance over 0.6.
